metadata.title: Gresco Tires | Premium Quality Tires in Egypt

hero.description: Premium tires from world-renowned brands, expert installation, and unparalleled service for all vehicle types.

about.subtitle: About Gresco Tires
about.title: Setting the Standard for Tire Excellence in Egypt
about.description: At Gresco Tires, we believe that safety and performance start where the rubber meets the road. Since our inception, we have been committed to providing Egyptian drivers with the highest quality tires and unparalleled automotive services.
about.feature2: Authorized dealer for premium global brands

services.subtitle: Our Expertise
services.title: Comprehensive Auto Services
services.description: Beyond premium tires, we offer a full suite of automotive services to keep your vehicle running safely and efficiently on Egyptian roads.
services.tireFittingDesc: Precision fitting and dynamic balancing for a smooth, vibration-free ride.
services.wheelAlignmentDesc: Advanced 3D alignment to ensure even tire wear and optimal handling.
services.brakeServicesDesc: Comprehensive brake inspections and pad replacements for your safety.
services.suspensionCheckDesc: Thorough inspection of shocks and struts to maintain vehicle stability.
services.batteryReplacementDesc: Quick diagnostics and replacement with premium battery brands.
services.nitrogenInflationDesc: Maintain tire pressure longer and improve fuel efficiency with nitrogen.

productsSection.passengerCarsDesc: Comfort and performance for daily commuting.
productsSection.suvDesc: Durability and traction for off-road adventures.
productsSection.commercialDesc: Heavy-duty tires for maximum load capacity.

ahmed.name: Ahmed Hassan
ahmed.content: Gresco Tires provided exceptional service. The team was professional, and the tire fitting was incredibly fast. Highly recommended for anyone in Cairo.

mona.name: Mona El-Sayed
mona.content: I was unsure which tires to get for my SUV, but their experts guided me perfectly. The prices are competitive, and the quality is unmatched.

karim.name: Karim Youssef
karim.content: We rely on Gresco for our entire company fleet. Their commercial tires are durable, and their maintenance service keeps our vehicles on the road.
